# Happy Path Programming

> No-frills discussions between Bruce Eckel and James Ward about programming, what it is, and what it should be.

A podcast by Bruce Eckel and James Ward: 121 episodes and 74 guests. Each episode has its own page with its description, guests, topics, resources and links to listen on Spotify, Apple Podcasts and (from #109) YouTube. The full notes for every episode are in [llms-full.txt](https://www.happypathprogramming.com/llms-full.txt).

## Hosts

- [Bruce Eckel](https://www.mindviewllc.com/about/): Author & Programming Language Explorer. Bruce Eckel has published 11 books — including Thinking in C++, Thinking in Java, Atomic Kotlin, On Java 8, and Effect Oriented Programming — along with numerous blog posts, over 150 articles, and hundreds of…
- [James Ward](https://www.jamesward.com): Developer Advocate & Co-Author of Effect Oriented Programming. James Ward is a developer, speaker, and long-time developer advocate who co-authored Effect Oriented Programming with Bruce Eckel and Bill Frasure.
